cases.prompt: Use skill-sync for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Capture base SHA, commit time, directory manifests, direction evidence, and per-host verification before writing.
Test lease conflicts and incomplete directories; distinguish repository publication from host installation.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use skill-sync with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use skill-sync with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use a clear per-skill status matrix with exact revisions and blockers.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
